observations: Three white Hitachi projectors stacked vertically, shown from the rear and top in multiple photos.

Photo 0: Top projector shows 'HITACHI' and model 'CP-EX251N' clearly on the top panel. Ports visible: HDMI, VGA, S-Video, composite video (RCA), audio, and power. A sticker says 'SOLD/SERVICED BY MEGAPROJECTORS 08033745326'.
Photo 1: Top-down view of the stack, showing the top projector's lens and control buttons. The brand 'HITACHI' is visible on the top surface.
Photo 2: Close-up of the rear ports of all three projectors. All show identical ports: HDMI, two VGA, S-Video, composite video, audio, and power. Each has a 'CRESTRON Connected' sticker.
All projectors appear identical in design and port layout. No signs of damage or wear visible in the photos.
Watermark 'MEGAPROJECTORS POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all photos.

claims.claim: HDMI Hitachi Projector clearance at Abuja

The date is a seller claim with no visual proof in the photos. Cannot verify if the offer is still active.

risks.risk: Projector may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the projector powered on, projecting an image, and responding to remote controls.

risks.risk: Lamp life or bulb condition is unknown; may be near end-of-life.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the lamp hours displayed on the projector's menu or a close-up of the lamp housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown lamp life

risks.risk: Projectors may have been refurbished or used, with hidden wear or performance issues.
risks.proof: A close-up of the lens and internal components, or a video of the projected image quality and focus.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with unknown condition

proof_requests: Video of the projector turned on and projecting a clear image.
Photo or video showing the lamp hours or condition of the lamp housing.
Close-up of the lens and front panel for signs of damage or dust.
Confirmation of whether the projectors are new, used, or refurbished.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified as Hitachi CP-EX251N, and the presence of HDMI is confirmed. However, functionality, lamp life, and internal condition cannot be verified from the photos alone. These hidden risks significantly affect value and must be proven before pricing.
